Who we are

A family’s loss, turned into hope for other families.

The J. Roberto Oaxaca Foundation was created to honor the legacy of Juan Roberto Oaxaca and to transform personal experiences of loss, resilience and service into opportunities to help others.

Following the loss of their daughter, Eva Sofía, and after years of service to families in the region, Claudia Oaxaca and her family committed themselves to creating an organization dedicated to restoring hope and strengthening families.

Today, the mission continues through programs designed to provide emotional, spiritual, educational and community support.

What we believe

We believe in prevention, empowerment and the power of community.

Mission

To strengthen and restore families by providing emotional, educational and community support before crisis becomes devastation.

Vision

To be a leading organization recognized for strengthening families and restoring hope throughout the border region.

Values

  • Hope
  • Service
  • Compassion
  • Integrity
  • Respect

Why strong families matter

Families in our region face real challenges every day.

  • Marital conflict
  • Anxiety and depression
  • Parenting struggles
  • Financial stress
  • Social isolation
  • Loss of hope

When families struggle, communities feel the impact.

Why families come to us

Our commitment is to listen, empower and support.

  • A safe and secure place to talk
  • Genuine people ready to help, without judgement

  • Hope in the most difficult times
